ctbids-48925-5696256.description:
Stunning Vintage Sterling Silver Ornate Floral Repousse Bon-Bon / Nut Dish
Up for auction is a gorgeous vintage sterling silver shallow serving dish, perfect for use as a bon-bon bowl, nut dish, trinket tray, or elegant tabletop accent.
This piece features an exquisite, deeply sculpted rim decorated with high-relief (repoussé) floral clusters and classic baroque-style scrolls. The undulating scalloped edge catches the light beautifully, framing a smooth, mirror-polished center well. It balances a delicate antique aesthetic with substantial mid-century craftsmanship.
Item Details:
Composition: Sterling Silver
Maker: Consistent with Amston Silver Co. patterns, but unconfirmed
Markings: Clearly stamped "STERLING" on the underside base along with pattern markings.
Design/Style: Baroque / Art Nouveau Revival featuring heavy floral and scroll repoussé work.
Condition: Excellent vintage condition, yet base shows dents. Shows gorgeous natural patina and minimal surface wear consistent with age and light use.

280029626.description:
Crystal and Mineral Specimen Collection
6-Piece Natural Stone Lot
Amethyst and Agate, Various Sizes
A curated collection of six natural crystal and mineral specimens, featuring vibrant amethyst formations and polished agate slabs. This lot includes a variety of textures and finishes, from raw druzy clusters to high-gloss polished points, making it an excellent addition to any geological display or home decor collection. These natural specimens showcase the unique crystalline structures and geological variations found in earth-mined stones.
Polished Amethyst tower with deep purple hues and faceted top
Large amethyst druzy cluster plate with natural matrix backing
Small chunky amethyst crystal cluster
Pair of matching agate geode halves featuring distinctive blue centers
Large polished agate slab with a semi-translucent body and teal inclusion
Total weight approximately 4.2 pounds
Condition:
Natural geological specimens with inherent variations. Polished surfaces are smooth with a high-gloss finish; some minor surface scuffs may be present on edges. Amethyst crystals are intact with no significant crushing or shedding. Agate halves show natural rough exterior texture with clean interior faces. No major repairs or structural cracks observed beyond natural geological fissures.
